ActionBatch.description: Body of `POST /builds/{id}/actions`: at most `BATCH_MAX` rows, added all or nothing.
ActionBatch.title: ActionBatch

ActionRow.description:
One action of a build. `add_actions` takes rows; missing `queued_at` means now.

`rule`, `params` and `toolchain` are what the plan says the action is (P2-04: provenance
queries show them and `ebs tests` selects `*.sim` rules by them); they are set when the
action is added and never change. Rows written before P2-04 hold None.
ActionRow.title: ActionRow

ArchiveRecord.description: A sign-off bundle of a release written to cold storage (`archives` table, P3-04 R2).
ArchiveRecord.title: ArchiveRecord

ArchiveRequest.description: Body of `POST /releases/{id}/archives`; the author is the authenticated caller.
ArchiveRequest.title: ArchiveRequest

BlobRef.description: A CAS object to register in the `blobs` table (GC bookkeeping, P1-09 R1).
BlobRef.title: BlobRef

BuildCreate.description: Everything known about a build when it starts.
BuildCreate.title: BuildCreate

BuildFinish.description: Body of `finish_build`; the store checks that `status` is final.
BuildFinish.title: BuildFinish

BuildView.description: A stored build with its status and per-state action counts (`ebs status`).
BuildView.title: BuildView

CacheHits.description: Response of `cache_get_many`: only the keys that hit, by their digest string.
CacheHits.title: CacheHits

Changed.description: Whether a `cache_put` inserted or a `cache_replace_failed` replaced the entry.
Changed.title: Changed

ChannelList.description: Response of the channel reads; `GET /channels` holds zero or one channel.
ChannelList.title: ChannelList

ChannelMove.description: One entry of a channel's history.
ChannelMove.title: ChannelMove

ChannelSet.description: Body of `PUT /channels`: the service checks the channel's gate itself.
ChannelSet.title: ChannelSet

DigestBatch.description: Body of `touch` and `cache_get_many`: at most `BATCH_MAX` digests.
DigestBatch.title: DigestBatch

DomainStats.description: What the dashboard's metrics pages show for the builds created in `since..until`.
DomainStats.title: DomainStats

DriverLease.description:
Who drives a build, until when (P2-08 R3). `owner` is opaque to the store
(`host:pid:token` by convention).
DriverLease.title: DriverLease

ErrorBody.description: Every error response: an actionable message (`MetadataError` text on the client).
ErrorBody.title: ErrorBody

Event.description: A driver event (interfaces.md § 10); `ebs.driver.events` re-exports this model.
Event.title: Event

ExportRecord.description: The audit row of a cross-domain export (`exports` table).
ExportRecord.title: ExportRecord

GateCheck.description:
A passed channel gate: `build` is a passing build of project `flow` that consumed the
release (provenance edges), checked when the channel moved.
GateCheck.title: GateCheck

LeaseRequest.description: Body of `acquire_lease` and `renew_lease` (whose `digests` are added to the lease).
LeaseRequest.title: LeaseRequest

OutputResult.description: One produced output: its content digest and the id passed downstream.
OutputResult.title: OutputResult

PendingWait.description:
Time actions spent pending for one reason; `feature` splits `licenses` waits by license
feature (the `licenses` of the `pending` event), "" when the event named none.
PendingWait.title: PendingWait

PilotSlot.description:
What one pilot offers when it asks for work (P3-06 R3): its allocation, the walltime it
has left for an action, and the licenses and node features its job was granted.
PilotSlot.title: PilotSlot

PinRequest.description: Body of `pin_build`; the pin's author is the authenticated caller.
PinRequest.title: PinRequest

ProvenanceAction.description:
An action row whose key a walk reached, with its build. Several builds may hold the same
key (cache hits); each row is listed.
ProvenanceAction.title: ProvenanceAction

ProvenanceEdge.description:
One `provenance_edges` row: `in` holds an input id at its logical path, `out` an output
(by name) with its passed-down id and its content digest.
ProvenanceEdge.title: ProvenanceEdge

ProvenanceGraph.description:
The result of a walk: every edge of the walked actions (sorted by key, direction, path),
their action rows (by build, action id), the releases holding an id of the graph (by id,
output) and whether `depth` stopped the walk before its end.
ProvenanceGraph.title: ProvenanceGraph

ProvenanceRelease.description: A release output of the domain whose id is in the graph.
ProvenanceRelease.title: ProvenanceRelease

QueueEntry.description: Where one queue item stands; `exit_code` and `infra_reason` are the runner's (`done`).
QueueEntry.title: QueueEntry

QueueIds.description: Body of `queue_status` and `queue_cancel`, and the response of `queue_put`.
QueueIds.title: QueueIds

QueueItem.description:
One action for the pilots of a pool: what the runner needs to find it, and what it needs
of a pilot's allocation (`slot_fits`). `features` are the node features of its constraint.
QueueItem.title: QueueItem

QueueLease.description: An item a pilot leased: run it, renew the lease before `expires_at`, then finish it.
QueueLease.title: QueueLease

QueuePut.description: Body of `queue_put`: at most `BATCH_MAX` items (the client splits larger puts).
QueuePut.title: QueuePut

RegisterOutcome.description:
What `register_toolchain` did: whether it inserted the row, and which rows of the same
module it marked as superseded by this one.
RegisterOutcome.title: RegisterOutcome

ReleaseCreate.description:
A release to create. `outputs` maps `release_output_name(action, output)` to the result
the action recorded; the store checks every entry against the build (P2-02 R1).
`allow_failed` is the reason given for releasing outputs of actions that did not pass.
ReleaseCreate.title: ReleaseCreate

ReleaseImport.description: One `release_imports` row: a build consumed `release` through import `alias`.
ReleaseImport.title: ReleaseImport

ReleaseOutput.description: One released output: where it comes from and the result it had in the build.
ReleaseOutput.title: ReleaseOutput

ReleaseView.description: A stored release. Immutable: only the yank fields are ever set, once (I19).
ReleaseView.title: ReleaseView

ResourceUsage.description: Measured resource use, in whole units (canonical JSON has no floats).
ResourceUsage.title: ResourceUsage

ResultManifest.description:
What an action produced; the value of the action cache (interfaces.md § 6).

`status="failed"` means the tool ran and reported failure, which is cacheable; infrastructure
failures never produce a manifest. `inputs` maps each staged logical path to its input id and
feeds the `in` provenance edges.
ResultManifest.title: ResultManifest

ResultSummary.description:
What the regression grid shows of an action's ResultManifest (`summary` holds e.g. the
test, seed and failure `signature` of a `questa.sim` result).
ResultSummary.title: ResultSummary

RunnerInfo.description: Where the result was produced; not part of the cache identity.
RunnerInfo.title: RunnerInfo

StateChange.description: Body of `set_action_state`; the store validates `state` and `fields` (`ActionUpdate`).
StateChange.title: StateChange

StepStats.description:
One step's actions in a stats window: those served from the cache and those that ran.
`cached_cpu_s` sums the CPU time recorded in the cached results (what the cache saved).
StepStats.title: StepStats

ToolchainCreate.description:
A toolchain snapshot to register (P1-07; data-model.md `toolchains`).

`id` must equal `ebs.toolchain.model.toolchain_id(module, version, fingerprint, env)`: the
registry computes it, and checks it again on every read (stores cannot, see `_common`).
`name` is the module without its version (`questa` for `questa/2025.2`).
ToolchainCreate.title: ToolchainCreate

ToolchainList.description: Response of the toolchain reads; `get` and `current` hold zero or one record.
ToolchainList.title: ToolchainList

ToolchainManifest.description: Response of `GET /toolchains/{id}/manifest`: base64, or None for an unknown id.
ToolchainManifest.title: ToolchainManifest

ToolchainRecord.description: A registered toolchain. Only `superseded_by` and `last_used_at` ever change.
ToolchainRecord.title: ToolchainRecord

ToolchainRegistration.description: Body of `POST /toolchains`: the snapshot and its manifest, base64 (standard alphabet).
ToolchainRegistration.title: ToolchainRegistration

YankRequest.description: Body of `POST /releases/{id}/yank`; the author is the authenticated caller.
YankRequest.title: YankRequest
